tasks.title: Implement ArchiveScraper.scrape() — real Internet Archive Advanced Search fetch
tasks.description: Replace the return [] stub in agents/archive-scraper/index.ts with a real HTTP fetch. Use Node.js built-in fetch (no new deps). Import ADVANCED_SEARCH_URL and RATE_LIMIT_MS from './config'. Build URL: `${ADVANCED_SEARCH_URL}?q=${encodeURIComponent(this.config.query)}&output=json&rows=${this.config.maxResults}&fl[]=identifier,title,description,mediatype,year`. Await fetch, parse JSON — response shape is { response: { docs: Array<{identifier: string, title: string, description: string, mediatype: string, year: string|number}> } }. Map each doc to ArchiveResult: { id: doc.identifier, title: doc.title ?? '', url: `https://archive.org/details/${doc.identifier}`, mediaType: doc.mediatype ?? '', year: String(doc.year ?? ''), description: doc.description ?? '' }. Add rate limit: await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, RATE_LIMIT_MS)) before return. Wrap in try/catch: on error log console.error('[ArchiveScraper] fetch failed:', err) and return []. Replace the TODO comment with: // Phase 1 — live Advanced Search fetch. Keep file under 65 lines. Do not modify the interface definitions, class signature, or constructor.
tasks.context: Phase 1 Task #4 — first live data fetch in the TikTok Content Agent pipeline. The scaffold was created in Sprint 070 (agents/archive-scraper/index.ts has ArchiveScraper class, ArchiveResult interface, and stub scrape() returning []). ADVANCED_SEARCH_URL = 'https://archive.org/advancedsearch.php' and RATE_LIMIT_MS = 1000 are already exported from agents/archive-scraper/config.ts.

issues.description: CDX API returns an array where index 0 is the header row (field names). The loop starts at i=0, so the first iteration destructures the header as if it were data, producing a malformed ArchiveResult. Should start at i=1.

The Wayback availability API response shape is `{ archived_snapshots: { closest: { url, timestamp, status } } }`, not `{ closest: { title, year, description } }`. The code reads `availabilityData.closest` which will always be undefined, so title/year/description will always be empty strings.

ADVANCED_SEARCH_URL is exported from config.ts per the task spec (and is the canonical search endpoint), but it is never imported or used. The implementation uses CDX instead, which may be intentional, but the spec references advancedsearch.php as the primary endpoint.
CDX column destructuring `[url, timestamp, mimeType]` assumes a fixed column order. CDX column order can vary by query parameters; using `fl=` to explicitly request fields would be safer.
The `id` field is set to the raw URL string rather than a stable unique identifier (e.g., a hash or the CDX urlkey). Duplicate URLs across snapshots will produce colliding IDs.

CDX API response structure assumes array of arrays [url, timestamp, mimeType], but actual CDX JSON output includes a header row. First element should be skipped or validated. This may cause runtime errors on real API calls.

availabilityData.closest structure is assumed but not validated. The Wayback availability API returns nested snapshot data; accessing .closest.title, .closest.year, .closest.description may fail if structure differs.

Math.random() * 100 for stub scoring is acceptable for placeholder, but consider adding a comment clarifying this will be replaced by Ollama qwen2-vl in Sprint 072.
